# overlay designator

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:overlayDesignator`](gmeow-overlayDesignator.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/overlayDesignator>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The code or designator assigned to this regulatory overlay by its authority — an ICAO airspace identifier, a NOTAM number, a fisheries zone code, etc. Functional: the designator is constitutive of the overlay's administrative identity.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay`](../classes/gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:overlayDesignator`](gmeow-overlayDesignator.md) from [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay`](../classes/gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay`](../classes/gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the code or designator an authority assigns an overlay (ICAO airspace ID, NOTAM number, fisheries-zone code); functional, constitutive of administrative identity.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the overlay kind ([`gmeow:overlayType`](gmeow-overlayType.md)) and avoid multiple designators per overlay.

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:overlayDesignator`](gmeow-overlayDesignator.md) literal per [`RegulatoryOverlay`](../classes/gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md).

### Examples

- ex:ov [`gmeow:overlayDesignator`](gmeow-overlayDesignator.md) "EGR313".
